entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: count_values requires a string-literal label name as the first arg
entries.rationale: the parser's typechecker admits only a string literal as count_values' first argument, same as lowerCountValues's identical check (internal/promql/lower.go)

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: 'bool' modifier is only allowed on comparison binary ops
entries.rationale: the parser rejects `bool` on non-comparison operators ("bool modifier can only be used on comparison operators"), same as lowerSumOrAvgOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp's identical check (histogram_native_mixed_or_aggregate.go, cerberus issue #2346) and its histogram_native_mixed_or_aggregate_presence.go / histogram_native_mixed_or_aggregate_float_only.go siblings (cerberus issue #2595). countValuesOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp only ever matches b via mixedExpHistogramSetOp, which requires b.Op == parser.LOR — `or` is a set operator, never a comparison, so the parser can never have set ReturnBool on it.

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: count_values requires a non-empty label name
